'''[[Gorak]]s''' were intended to be found in [[Daemonheim]] while training the [[Dungeoneering]] skill, but they were scrapped before release for unknown reasons. It is unknown which set of floors they would have been found on, or if they would have possessed the stat-draining attacks of standard goraks.
